source: raygui.h v5.1-dev (RAYGUI_VERSION_MAJOR 5, RAYGUI_VERSION_MINOR 1) as shipped in raylib 6.2 examples/*/raygui.h

GuiSetAlpha.scope: guiAlpha clamped to [0, 1]; every control color is faded by it.

GuiSetFont.scope: When the font texture id is above 0, the gui draws and measures its texts with the font (glyph widths, TEXT_SIZE over its base size, DrawTextCodepoint with its texture, MeasureTextEx for tooltips); the gui keeps a Data copy (J.Font.Shared) and the font comes back.
gaps: A copy instead of the struct with shared pointers (language adaptation): each text drawn rebuilds the font from the copy, slower for a large atlas
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiGetFont.scope: GetFontDefault for a new gui, or a font equal to the one GuiSetFont set; Gui.font_base_size is its baseSize.
gaps: An equal font instead of the same struct (language adaptation)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiSetStyle.scope: guiStyle[control*24 + property] (a property of 24 or more reaches the next rows, as raygui writes them); a DEFAULT base property reaches every control.
gaps: An index outside the 16x24 table changes nothing (raygui writes outside its array)

GuiLoadStyle.scope: A file whose first byte is '#' is read as text: fgets chunks of up to 255 bytes (a last line without a newline is not read), 'p' lines through sscanf("p %d %d 0x%x") whose targets keep their values between lines, 'v' lines setting the version (raygui 5.1-dev), 'f' lines ("f %d %31s %31[^\r\n]s": the charmap then the font file, the font file first from version 600) loading a font (LoadFontEx with the charmap's codepoints, relative to the style's directory) or the default font with TEXT_SIZE 10 and TEXT_SPACING 1. Any other file is GuiLoadStyleFromMemory.
gaps: Undefined in raygui and marked so: GuiSetStyle indices outside the table, sscanf values outside their types, reads past the file, data that does not inflate to what is read next, fonts with no glyphs or a base size below 1

Refused although raygui runs them: an 'f' line without a charmap name, a sign or second 0x in a hex value, a 'v' value with a '-' or of 2^31 or more, image formats above 13 and samples Jonlib's images refuse, a style path past GetDirectoryPath's buffer
A directory is a file that does not open
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiLoadStyleFromMemory.scope: The binary .rgs format (public in raygui 5.1-dev): rGS signature, properties (a DEFAULT base property reaches every control), then an optional font (from version 600 after its file's 32-byte name) whose atlas, rects and glyphs are raw or DEFLATE-compressed (version 400 sizes), read before its texture loads; set with GuiSetFont, its positive white rectangle becoming the shapes texture's source when the texture loaded, else the default font.
gaps: Undefined in raygui and marked so: data shorter than the 12-byte header, GuiSetStyle indices outside the table, reads past the data, data that does not inflate to what is read next, fonts with no glyphs or a base size below 1
Refused although raygui runs them: image formats above 13 and samples Jonlib's images refuse
Compared through GuiLoadStyle (the probe's style files)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiLoadStyleDefault.scope: The default style table as raygui 5.1-dev fills it (TEXT_LINE_SPACING 12, TABBAR's TAB_ITEMS_WIDTH 160; a new Gui holds it).
